 Here’s When Every Episode of ‘The Terminal List’ Season 2 Drops 
 Here’s When Every Episode of ‘The Terminal List’ Season 2 Drops 
 The Prime Video series is back after an especially long hiatus. 
 By Leah Marilla Thomas Published: Oct 22, 2026 Save Article Share Article Marni Grossman // Amazon Prime The Terminal List has returned to Prime Video for a second season of Chris Pratt as a vengeful former Navy SEAL named James Reece. Are you more than ready for more of this action-packed series? Here’s what you need to know about The Terminal List season 2’s episode release schedule.
 Didn’t this show’s first season come out in 2022? Correct! The Terminal List was over four years ago; which, even by streaming standards, is a very long hiatus. It’s not like they were hurting for material. The series is based on Jack Carr’s novel series. There are seven books in that series, and an eighth will be published next year. Nevertheless, The Terminal List is back for a second season in 2026. Gabriel Luna and Yul Vazquez joined the cast. So have Luke Hemsworth and Tom Hopper, who both appeared in a prequel series titled The Terminal List: Dark Wolf in 2025. To be fair, Pratt and his co-star Taylor Kitsch were also in Dark Wolf , so it was kind of like a season 1.5, or season 0.5, since it takes place before.
 Without further ado, how can you keep up with the new season of the original series? It’s actually pretty simple.
 When does The Terminal List Season 2 premiere?
 Unlike other Prime Video releases that usually follow a weekly release format for their later seasons, the entire second season will premiere on Prime Video on October 21, 2026.
 How many episodes are in The Terminal List Season 2?
 The new season of The Terminal List will have eight episodes in total. That’s the same as season 1 and one more than Dark Wolf , if you’re keeping track. Since they’re all dropping at once, you’ll need to either clear some time over the weekend or plan to avoid certain online spaces that could provide spoilers.
 Here’s the full ‘The Terminal List’ Season 2 episode release schedule:
 Episode 1, “Romulus S.V.”, October 21, 2026
 Episode 2, “Warrior in a Garden”, October 21, 2026
 Episode 3, “Shooter Ready”, October 21, 2026
 Episode 4, “Into the Labyrinth”, October 21, 2026
 Episode 5, “Frogman Sh$t”, October 21, 2026
 Episode 6, “Rats in a Maze”, October 21, 2026
 Episode 7, “Every Bullet Has Its Destiny”, October 21, 2026
 Episode 8, “Fathers and Sons”, October 21, 2026
 Any early word on season 3 of The Terminal List? 
 The series hasn’t officially been renewed for a third season just yet, so it’s still up in the air. Basically, if you want to see more, your’e definitely going to want to tune in ASAP!
